citation_policy: Cite the edition, the version, and the URL. Each edition page carries a formatted citation. Version 1.0.0 of each edition is the migration of the blog library’s served text; the version date is the blog’s own import date, recorded in the version note.

blog.relation: The texts stand on their own; the essays are one reader’s reading.
